rules: Any liquid asset: stock, crypto, or leveraged/inverse ETF
Rotate each 6:30am CT run — sell yesterday, buy today's best
Leverage matched to conviction; asymmetric payoff preferred
Hard stop at entry; spot-crypto-only on weekends

positions.name: Solana
positions.catalyst: SOL just reclaimed the pivotal $80 resistance (live $81.79) after a ~19% week, the strongest major-crypto momentum. Fresh ecosystem catalysts: surging tokenized-stock trading on Solana and the launch of World, a new on-chain prediction market, driving real network activity and outperformance vs BTC/ETH.
positions.driver: Weekend/holiday = spot-crypto-only; among the majors SOL offers the most asymmetric next-24h payoff — a clean breakout over $80 opens a technical path toward ~$120, with tight invalidation on a loss of $80. Spot (unleveraged) caps drawdown to SOL's own vol; no leverage stacked on an already-extended move.
positions.risks: SOL is the highest-beta major and positioning has been crowded long — a failed breakout back below $80 (retest $76-78) or a thin-liquidity weekend risk-off flush is the key risk. The 10% hard stop ($73.61) bounds the downside; BTC (lower-vol, already up) and ETH (mid-momentum) were the safer runners-up.
